stem: A crop plan assumes every cultivar will stretch and finish on the same schedule. What is the main planning weakness?
choices: Genotype-specific growth and developmental timing can alter space, labor, and harvest assumptions
Cultivar identity matters only after harvest
All photoperiod cultivars have identical architecture
Genetics affect flavor but not production planning
rationale: Cultivar-specific architecture and timing can materially affect occupancy, canopy management, labor, and harvest scheduling.
